import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/training_3.csv"
]

# Load all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# According to operation_history: UNION of all source tables
# All source tables have the same schema, so union is valid
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Project only the 'occluded' column as per target schema
target_df = union_df[['occluded']].copy()

# Ensure 'occluded' column is integer type as in target schema
target_df['occluded'] = target_df['occluded'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_90/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
